identity:
This statue offers a variety of services.  You can be instantly healed, dispel an ongoing portal storm, check your current statistics and progress, and tweak your expedition difficulty settings.

Healing is free until you have survived 10 expeditions.  After this point, healing costs 4 warp shards per treatment.

Expedition difficulty is set to default when you start a new game, but here you can change many finer details to suit your own playstyle.
